title: Receipt Dated Thursday
summary: Continuity Voice reads a poodle’s return receipt from a store that will not exist until Thursday. The barcode is always one digit short.
visualArc: Thermal slip → heist under chairs → incomplete scan → rift lot → receipt in the minutes → return, still short.

segments.label: Thermal slip
segments.onScreen: Receipt: GAVEL CRACKED, date THURSDAY, barcode missing last digit.
segments.lyrics: Item: gavel, cracked, character included. / Returned by: Biscuit. / Store: not yet.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Macro photoreal of a cheap thermal receipt, slightly purple-tinted paper, item line GAVEL CRACKED, date THURSDAY, barcode with the last digit missing, fluorescent lobby light, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Heist under chairs
segments.onScreen: Poodle, purple bandana, cracked gavel, folding chairs.
segments.lyrics: She took it under the folding chairs. / No explanation. No apology.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Low tracking shot of a standard poodle in a glowing purple bandana trotting under rows of folding chairs with a cracked wooden gavel in her mouth, HOA meeting in progress above, deadpan comedy, filmic, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 22-second low track. Nails on tile. Photoreal.

segments.label: Incomplete scan
segments.onScreen: Scanner, seven tones, poodle nose, EyeWash CRT.
segments.lyrics: Receipt dated Thursday / The barcode is short one number / We are not authorized to guess
segments.musicCue: Barcode beep always seven tones, not eight
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Close-up of a grocery barcode scanner beeping seven tones over a receipt dated Thursday, poodle nose at the edge of frame, EyeWash Station color bars on a tiny lobby CRT, photoreal, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Rift lot
segments.onScreen: Empty lot, violet rift, receipt on a survey stake.
segments.lyrics: Change: a store that opens next Thursday on a lot that is currently a rift.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Empty suburban lot at night where a store should be, a violet rift where the parking spaces would go, a receipt taped to a survey stake, no people, cinematic, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Tuck it in the minutes
segments.onScreen: Clipboard, receipt in the minutes, purple bandana on the clip.
segments.lyrics: The dog has a paper trail. / The paper trail has a dog.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: HOA clipboard with a thermal receipt tucked into the minutes, purple bandana caught on the clip, fluorescent clubhouse, deadpan, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Return, still short
segments.onScreen: Poodle in an aisle that does not exist yet; last beep still short.
segments.lyrics: Thank you for shopping where we aren't yet. / We'll return to your program. We always do.
segments.musicCue: Spoken small print; last incomplete beep
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Poodle sitting politely in a fluorescent aisle that does not exist yet, cracked gavel on the linoleum, receipt in a bow, last barcode beep missing its digit, photoreal, Grok Imagine style
